hero.title: About VisionTaubaté
hero.subtitle: Technology with Vision, Innovation with Purpose

intro.p1: Since 2015, <1>VisionTaubaté</1> has been blending creativity, technology, and Christian values to boost businesses and turn ideas into real solutions. We started our journey in the visual communication segment, helping companies stand out with brand identity and presence.
intro.p2: But it was in 2019, when we entered systems and app development, that we expanded our purpose: <1>to use technology to generate impact and transformation.</1>
intro.p3: More than just delivering projects, we want to <1>be part of our clients' evolution</1>. That's why we put God first in everything we do and conduct our work with ethics, excellence, and a true spirit of service.
